restriction.android:title: Enable HTTPS Payload Inspection
restriction.android:description: Turn on MITM traffic interception for all managed apps.

restriction.android:title: Enterprise Legal Consent Pre-confirmed
restriction.android:description: Set to true to confirm that the organisation has obtained the necessary legal consent to monitor employee HTTPS traffic on this device. When true the app skips the in-app consent dialog.

restriction.android:title: Install CA Certificate Automatically
restriction.android:description: When true and the app is Device Owner or Profile Owner, the PrivacyGuard CA is installed into the system trust store silently without any user prompt. All apps on the device (or work profile) will then trust certificates signed by PrivacyGuard.

restriction.android:title: Redact PII from Payloads
restriction.android:description: Automatically redact personally identifiable information (emails, phone numbers, credit cards, passwords) before storing or shipping payloads.

restriction.android:title: Payload Log Retention (days)
restriction.android:description: Number of days to keep intercepted payload logs on device. Allowed range: 1–90.

restriction.android:title: Ship Payloads to SIEM
restriction.android:description: Enable forwarding of intercepted payloads to the configured SIEM endpoint.

restriction.android:title: SIEM Endpoint URL
restriction.android:description: HTTPS URL of the log aggregation / SIEM server (e.g. https://siem.corp.example.com/api/events).

restriction.android:title: SIEM API Key
restriction.android:description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate requests to the SIEM endpoint.
